oldDescription: Create a required-name Project or patch a known project_id on the current node. Omitted fields are preserved; blank description clears. Optional workspaces reference absolute node-local folder paths: a supplied list replaces ALL links, [] unlinks only. Retained links preserve omitted descriptions. Returns saved metadata and links; does not register/delete workspaces or delegate work.

project_id.description: Known Project identity for patch; omit to create. Never resolved by name.

name.description: Trimmed non-empty Project name; required for create, optional for patch.

description.description: Project description; omit to preserve on patch, blank to clear.

workspaces.description: Complete desired workspace links, not append. Omit to preserve on patch; [] unlinks all without deleting folders. Use absolute folder paths on this node; registration and existence are not required.

workspace_path.description: Absolute folder path on this node; no shell expansion or registration required.

description.description: Link description; omit to preserve a retained link, blank to clear. New links default to blank.
